title: Vendor spend forecast review
notes: Synthetic forecast-review case grounded in implemented Vendor transaction and derived-fact substrate; the planning ontology and forecast KPI contract are planned extensions.
reviewQuestions: Can finance compare actual spend, expected charges, and forecast assumptions without conflating them?
Does the design clearly identify which vendor commitments or renewals need action?
outcomes: A reviewer can explain a forecast variance and identify the assumption behind it.
A reviewer can prioritize a vendor follow-up or return the forecast for revision.
